bundle.shortDescription: Fast offline sprite sheet packer — slice images into frames and pack them into optimized atlases.
bundle.longDescription: Sprite Sheet Packer is a desktop tool that lets you drop images, automatically slice them into frames and pack the frames into one or multiple sprite sheets. Supports Sheets and Combine modes, canvas size presets, export to PNG/ZIP and more. Works completely offline.
